messages.author: Joe Leonard
messages.body:
Folks, we are currently looking at trying to get fortran 3rd party code
working on the new chipset and I wanted to ask whether you have looked into
getting the fortran components (assuming there ARE remnants) going on the
M1? We're looking at NAG Fortran, but having reproducibility issues. If
you've had progress, what compiler are you using?
Thanks in advance!
Joe
